title: Passive Leak Membrane Conductance
description: Ohmic passive neuronal membrane leak current mechanism (pas) establishing resting membrane potential and input resistance in NEURON compartmental simulations.

title: Hodgkin-Huxley Voltage-Gated Na+/K+ Channels
description: Classic squid giant axon Hodgkin-Huxley fast sodium (m^3 h), delayed rectifier potassium (n^4), and leak conductances for action potential generation.
code:
TITLE Hodgkin-Huxley Voltage-Gated Sodium and Potassium Channels

NEURON {
  SUFFIX hh_axon
  USEION na READ ena WRITE ina
  USEION k READ ek WRITE ik
  NONSPECIFIC_CURRENT il
  RANGE gnabar, gkbar, gl, el, gna, gk, ina, ik, il
  GLOBAL minf, hinf, ninf, mtau, htau, ntau
}

PARAMETER {
  gnabar = 0.12 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gkbar = 0.036 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  gl = 0.0003 (S/cm2) <0, 1e9>
  ena = 50.0 (mV)
  ek = -77.0 (mV)
  el = -54.3 (mV)
}

STATE {
  m
  h
  n
}

ASSIGNED {
  v (mV)
  gna (S/cm2)
  gk (S/cm2)
  ina (mA/cm2)
  ik (mA/cm2)
  il (mA/cm2)
}

INITIAL {
  m = 0.05
  h = 0.60
  n = 0.32
}

BREAKPOINT {
  SOLVE states METHOD cnexp
  gna = gnabar * (m^3) * h
  ina = gna * (v - ena)
  gk = gkbar * (n^4)
  ik = gk * (v - ek)
  il = gl * (v - el)
}

DERIVATIVE states {
  m' = (minf - m) / mtau
  h' = (hinf - h) / htau
  n' = (ninf - n) / ntau
}

title: Dual-Exponential Excitatory AMPA Synapse
description: Bi-exponential excitatory glutamatergic synaptic conductance with coupled rise and decay gating states modeling postsynaptic AMPA receptor currents.

title: L-Type Calcium Channel with Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz Flux
description: High-voltage-activated L-type calcium channel combining activation and calcium-dependent inactivation gating states with nonlinear GHK permeation driving force.

title: Cortical Pyramidal Neuron Complete Ion Channel Suite
description: Multi-mechanism biophysical membrane suite for a neocortical Layer-5 pyramidal neuron combining fast Na+, delayed rectifier K+, muscarinic M-current, and Ca2+ pump.
